Kill [[Molotov Rocktail]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Molotov Rocktail in the [[Dalada Uplands]].
* *BONUS* Kill Molotov Rocktail in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
*5,000 [[Experience]]
*1,000 [[Gold]]
*1,250 [[Vanguard reputation point]]s
*Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
*Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As you approach his location, spread out the [[party]], using [[Hero flag|flags]] for [[hero]]es and [[henchmen]]; Rocktail's [[Devourer Siege|siege attack]] can easily [[wipe]] an entire party. That same [[spike]] also makes the boss vulnerable to damage reflection skills, especially [[Pain Inverter]]. 

* A group of [[Charr]] appears near the devourer's location; you can [[pull]] Rocktail away or just wait for the [[patrol]] to move away.
* You can use the nearby [[Siege Devourer]] to [[tank]] against both the [[Charr]] party and Rocktail.
